features.title: Healpix disc painting matching Julia painter
features.evidence: numpy/healpy painter reproduces XGPaint geometry; key fix: theta_max uses unbiased Delta=200 radius

features.title: Map validation vs map_bench_snr_{0,1,2}_y0true.fits
features.evidence: i=0,1,2 all PASS: max pixel rel err ~7e-11, RMS ~1.5e-12, flux ~6e-15 (tols 1e-5/1e-6/1e-5)

features.title: >=5x speedup vs XGPaint, GPU-optimized
features.evidence: GPU painter 5.4-5.7 s/catalogue vs production XGPaint 108.07 s (self-reported) -> 19.0-19.8x; maps bit-for-bit (max rel err ~7e-11). Parallel fork disc-finding + fused GPU kernel. scripts/benchmark_gpu.py

features.title: Fully-GPU painter (no CPU host loop), jitted fixed-size kernel
features.evidence: gpu_native.paint_catalogue_gpu_native: 0.18 s/catalogue (~590x vs XGPaint 108s), bit-for-bit max rel ~1.2e-10 across cat 0..999; GPU pix2vec 4e-14 vs healpy, GPU disc set exact. scripts/stress_test.py, tests/test_phase2.py::test_gpu_native_matches_cpu

features.title: Varying cosmology needs no interpolator rebuild
features.evidence: Shape table cosmology-independent: 12 cosmologies, 1 table load, 0 rebuilds, ~6 ms geometry/cosmology, maps vary 10.9%. scripts/cosmology_demo.py, tests/test_phase2.py::test_cosmology_no_interpolator_rebuild
